newNodes.name: test_s1_reconcile_revalidates_scheduled_state_inside_transaction
oracle: use the real DurableWal, ControlLedger, Controller and SQLite files under tmp_path

use a one-shot synchronized wrapper around ControlLedger.import_zero_entries so the outer 06:40 invocation has already observed Scheduled ABSENT, then a distinct writer completes a real 06:39 ENSURE_SCHEDULED dispatch before the outer ledger transaction continues
require the outer result decision ENSURE_AUDIT_OBSERVING_SCHEDULED, scheduledState ACTIVE and Audit slot target
inspect real control state and require Scheduled ACTIVE with no MISSED_SCHEDULED terminal row
do not accept a generic busy error, sleep-based race or mocked ledger result
newNodes.expectedCurrentFailure: outer result remains MISSED_SCHEDULED_AND_ENSURE_AUDIT or persists false MISSED_SCHEDULED

newNodes.name: test_s1_recovery_after_committed_journal_repairs_new_corruption
oracle: create a real generation-1 ledger, corrupt it and complete one real recovery to generation 2 with a COMMITTED journal
corrupt the reopened generation-2 SQLite header after all connections close
call the real recover_ledger again and require a different recoveryId, oldGeneration 2, newGeneration 3 and a different quarantinePath
call inspect_control_state or ControlLedger.verify after the second recovery and require integrity Green
require the prior COMMITTED journal remains preserved in recovery history
newNodes.expectedCurrentFailure: second call reuses generation-2 recovery identity or leaves verify corrupt

newNodes.name: test_s1_recover_wrapper_exposes_and_forwards_busy_timeout
oracle: inspect.signature on the real tools.news_grasp_cleanroom_dispatch.recover_ledger and require keyword-only busy_timeout_ms with default 1000

replace only the Controller constructor with a capturing test double, invoke recover_ledger with busy_timeout_ms=17 and require the constructor receives 17 and recover_ledger receives the exact observed_at
do not compare receipt strings without inspecting the real callable
newNodes.expectedCurrentFailure: signature lacks busy_timeout_ms or forwarding capture differs
